predict.question: Before a full launch, you run a small test, plan B: it nets 20 credits if the idea works and loses 5 if not, each equally likely. On average, what does plan B net?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: The Startup Owner’s Manual treats customer development as testing a business model before scaling it.
modelBoundary: A averages {A}; B {B}. The staged policy gives up ten in the success branch but saves fifteen in the failure branch. Policy branches and probabilities are stipulated; no test accuracy or actual channel discovery is claimed.
